zh: 每次只能把末尾的层拿出来插到别处，所以从来没被移动过的层一定是 current 的一个前缀：想保留某一层，它后面的层必须都被搬走。
没被移动的前缀相对顺序不变，因此它必须是 desired 的子序列；反过来，只要前缀是 desired 的子序列，就可以把其余层从尾部逐个取出插到目标位置。答案 = n − 能保留的最长前缀长度。
用双指针：i 指向 current 中待匹配的位置，j 扫描 desired；每当 current[i] == desired[j] 就 i++，j 每步都前进。扫描结束时 i 就是最长可保留前缀的长度，输出 n − i。
en: Each step can only take the last layer and insert it elsewhere, so the layers that are never moved must form a prefix of current: to keep a layer in place, every layer after it has to be moved away.

The unmoved prefix keeps its relative order, so it must be a subsequence of desired; conversely, if the prefix is a subsequence of desired, the remaining layers can be taken from the end one by one and inserted into their target positions. The answer is n minus the length of the longest prefix that can be kept.

Use two pointers: i is the next position of current to match and j scans desired; whenever current[i] == desired[j], increment i, and advance j every step. When the scan ends, i is the length of the longest keepable prefix, so print n - i.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Layers are moved from the end of current, so the part that is never moved must be a prefix of current. To use the fewest operations, find the longest prefix of current that still appears in its original order in desired; the remaining layers are taken from the end one by one and inserted into their target positions. Scan desired with two pointers to match the prefix of current; the answer is n minus the kept length.

## Correctness

Any element that is never moved can only come from a prefix of current; otherwise all elements after it would have to be moved away first, and that element itself would also be moved. The relative order of the unmoved prefix does not change, so it must be a subsequence of desired. Conversely, if the prefix is a subsequence of desired, the other elements can be taken one by one from the end of current and inserted into the corresponding gaps of desired, using exactly n minus the prefix length operations. Therefore the longest keepable prefix gives the minimum number of operations.

## Complexity

O(n) time and O(1) extra space.
